value.note: positive anchor: proves the rewritten cbuffer still declares a field of type InstanceDataStructType (i.e. the compile did not fail before reaching the point where this matters, and the reference to the type survived removal of the fully-unused sibling struct/cbuffer).

absence: the struct's own declaration must be present somewhere in the output for the emitted HLSL to be self-consistent. Its disappearance while still being referenced as a field type is exactly the defect quoted in the issue body.

note: Symptom is 'referenced struct declaration removed, cbuffer field of that type kept' -- an incorrect-code / self-consistency bug in dxr's -remove-unused-globals/-remove-unused-functions, not a crash. The all_of composition guards against the not_regex clause being satisfied for free by a failed/empty compile (see control-fail.hlsl / control-scalar.hlsl).
